text.p: These are the leading stories in the Botswana press on Friday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Leaders from 18 African Commonwealth countries are expected to attend a meeting of the round table of heads of state of Commonwealth Africa in Kasane, northern Botswana, on February 26 and 27.

- Minister of Presidential Affairs and Public Administation, Ponatshego Kedikilwe, said more efficient policing needs to be introduced to address the problem of illegal immigrants in southern Africa. He was talking at the end of a meeting of Southern African Regional Police Chiefs Co-operation Organisation (SARPCO) in Gaborone.
- Visiting South African traditional leaders and parliamentarians have been told by the head of Botswana's House of Chiefs, Kgosi Seepapitso IV, that traditional leaders should keep out of politics.
